purpose: Create the first genuine Exilada body pixel-art candidate by direct pixel-art authoring, not by reducing or filtering the approved high-resolution body reference.

authoring_source.external_authoring_engine: Grok image generation already in use for the approved body-reference workflow

logical_target.body_state: fully nude adult hairless body base
logical_target.background: transparent if supported; otherwise one flat chroma color with no shadow

enlarged_grid_contract.logical_pixel_representation: each authored logical pixel must appear as one uniform 4x4 output block
enlarged_grid_contract.pixel_clusters: deliberate connected clusters authored for the logical grid
enlarged_grid_contract.palette_target: controlled approximately 24-32 foreground colors; palette count alone is not a PASS criterion

allowed: remove a flat chroma background to alpha
strip the 4x display zoom by exact nearest-neighbor decimation / one logical sample per uniform block
measure native visible height and bounds without rescaling the body
generate native-1x, enlarged and 640x360 gameplay previews
hash and package an approved 2D asset
forbidden: resize the high-resolution body reference into the sprite
quantize or pixel-filter a painting/render and call it pixel art
mechanically trace the high-resolution silhouette into the final sprite
smooth/average/downsample non-grid artwork into native pixels
procedurally invent or repair final human anatomy
manually repaint frames as a routine production burden

visual_pass: reads immediately as intentional modern pixel art at native 1x
preserves approved adult Exilada proportions and body mass
face, hands, feet, chest, pelvis and legs are deliberately simplified rather than collapsed by reduction
silhouette is authored for gameplay readability
value grouping is cluster-based rather than render-like
retains mature severe sensual dangerous sword-and-sorcery presence
does not read as a pixelated photo/render, procedural mannequin, generic fitness model or low-resolution 3D
failure_policy: Reject/regenerate the direct-authored candidate; do not rescue it with filters or mechanical cleanup that changes anatomy/silhouette.
next_if_pass: Promote the accepted logical-grid image to the persistent B3B native 2D body source, then add deterministic import/QA/export tooling before B4.
next_if_fail: Keep B3B current and request another directly authored pixel candidate under the same contract; do not reopen closed local model routes automatically.
